institution: U.S. EPA · U.S. Coast Guard · DHS
title: Stormwater Fate & Transport of Biological Contaminants
description: Led high-resolution SWMM development to simulate Bacillus anthracis transport across urban surfaces under multiple storm scenarios, integrating custom Python automation and field observations for decontamination-strategy evaluation.
output_impact: Peer-reviewed SWMM study · automated modeling workflow · evidence for interagency emergency-response planning
funding: U.S. EPA Homeland Security Research Program

title: Climate-Sensitive Agricultural Management & Erosion Prediction
description: Simulated impacts of storm intensification and climate change on crop yield and soil loss under multiple tillage systems using WEPP and Python automation.
output_impact: Peer-reviewed climate-impact studies · automated multi-scenario WEPP workflow

institution: U.S. EPA · Robert S. Kerr Environmental Research Center
title: Advancing Streamflow Prediction with SWAT & Machine Learning
description: Developed hybrid SWAT–SVR and SWAT–Wavelet models to improve streamflow and sediment predictions while supporting EPA watershed and water-quality tool evaluation.
output_impact: Hybrid SWAT–SVR and SWAT–Wavelet frameworks · peer-reviewed publications and technical review

title: GIS Education & Technology Development
description: Developed GIS-based educational systems through university–industry collaboration, supporting interactive instruction, spatial analysis, and geographic visualization.
output_impact: Three registered GIS and geography educational software systems

title: Soil Erosion & GIS-Based Risk Mapping in the Loess Plateau
description: Principal Investigator of a rill-erosion modeling project using 3D Cellular Automata and GIS, validated through laboratory and field rainfall experiments and 3D laser scanning.
output_impact: 3D cellular-automata erosion model · field and laboratory validation
funding: National Natural Science Foundation of China · Grant No. 41001158

institution: Key Laboratory of Virtual Geographic Environment · Poyang Lake Basin
title: Agricultural Nonpoint-Source Pollution Risk Assessment
description: Developed GIS-based spatial multi-criteria models for nitrogen and phosphorus pollution-risk evaluation and created a database for watershed vulnerability zones.
output_impact: Watershed vulnerability maps · nutrient-risk assessment database

title: Climate–Hydrology–Substance Transport
description: Used geostatistics and wavelet analysis to simulate long-term runoff, rainfall variability, and sediment transport in the Poyang Lake Basin.
output_impact: Long-term hydro-climate analyses · peer-reviewed precipitation study
funding: Chinese Academy of Sciences Knowledge Innovation Program
